scope: Engine patches 0041-0043: a stream's silence guard hears each chunk before it is handed over, and a stream and a whole reply cut at the frame that completes 10 s of silence. On our GB10, our corpus. Measured on f5c11dea plus the same three changes, built before they were stacked on patch 0040; their code diff is identical. Neutralized from the captures; numbers unchanged.
pcm: mono 16-bit at 44.1 kHz; a whole reply's samples are its WAV data

default_voice_corpus.method: recipe/pilot.py without serve flags; bench/corpus_capture.py --passes 2 over the 24-text corpus (48 requests); bench/compare_gate.py against the baseline capture every earlier gate used; bench/stream_check.py
default_voice_corpus.long05_note: Cut at the frame that completes 10 s of silence, in both passes; the previous build cut it at the end of a 16-frame decode chunk, 20.8 s.
